name: math-skill-edges
description: Skills edge cases from review round 2 on 2aa2dc0. #13: quitting a run still updates earned stars and celebrates every skill it mastered, one level-up each. #14: a v1 Custom coach profile with stale table picks races every table and keeps its v1 best key. #5: importing a sibling's export names them and offers Undo. #6: a refused storage write reports failure instead of 'Imported'.

steps.label: answer one fact, then pause
steps.js: (async function(){function ans(){var t=document.getElementById('problem').textContent.split(' ');var a=+t[0],b=+t[2],o=t[1];return o==='+'?a+b:(o==='\u2212'?a-b:(o==='\u00d7'?a*b:a/b));}function type(n){String(n).split('').forEach(function(d){document.querySelector('#keypad [data-k="'+d+'"]').click();});}function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms);});}type(ans());await sleep(350);document.getElementById('pauseBtn').click();await sleep(100);return !document.getElementById('pauseOv').hidden;})()

steps.label: quitting still updates earned stars and celebrates each skill it mastered, first of two (review #13)
the second mastered skill gets its own moment
back home: both mastered, level-up closed
a v1 Custom coach profile (Coach on, 8 and 9 left picked) races every table and keeps its v1 best key (review #14)
steps.js: (async function(){function ans(){var t=document.getElementById('problem').textContent.split(' ');var a=+t[0],b=+t[2],o=t[1];return o==='+'?a+b:(o==='\u2212'?a-b:(o==='\u00d7'?a*b:a/b));}function type(n){String(n).split('').forEach(function(d){document.querySelector('#keypad [data-k="'+d+'"]').click();});}function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms);});}var n=0;while(!document.getElementById('runLayer').hidden&&n<30){type(ans());n++;await sleep(330);}var s=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('math.sessions.pAva.v1'));return n===10&&s.length===1&&s[0].cfgKey==='race|x|coach|m10|l10';})()

steps.label: import a sibling's export: it names whose skills they were and offers Undo (review #5)
steps.js: (async function(){function ans(){var t=document.getElementById('problem').textContent.split(' ');var a=+t[0],b=+t[2],o=t[1];return o==='+'?a+b:(o==='\u2212'?a-b:(o==='\u00d7'?a*b:a/b));}function type(n){String(n).split('').forEach(function(d){document.querySelector('#keypad [data-k="'+d+'"]').click();});}function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms);});}window.__before=localStorage.getItem('math.skills.pAva.v1');var doc=MathSkills.exportProfile('Mia',{},{'x-11-12':{stars:3,masteredAt:5}},Date.now());var dt=new DataTransfer();dt.items.add(new File([JSON.stringify(doc)],'mia.json',{type:'application/json'}));var inp=document.getElementById('importFile');inp.files=dt.files;inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));await sleep(400);var t=Array.prototype.map.call(document.querySelectorAll('.toast'),function(x){return x.textContent;}).join('|');var e=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('math.skills.pAva.v1'));return /Mia/.test(t)&&/Undo/.test(t)&&e['x-11-12']&&e['x-11-12'].stars===3;})()

steps.label: Undo puts the player's own skills back
steps.js: (async function(){function ans(){var t=document.getElementById('problem').textContent.split(' ');var a=+t[0],b=+t[2],o=t[1];return o==='+'?a+b:(o==='\u2212'?a-b:(o==='\u00d7'?a*b:a/b));}function type(n){String(n).split('').forEach(function(d){document.querySelector('#keypad [data-k="'+d+'"]').click();});}function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms);});}var b=document.querySelector('.toast .toastGo');b.click();await sleep(200);return localStorage.getItem('math.skills.pAva.v1')===window.__before;})()

steps.label: a refused write says so instead of 'Imported' (review #6)
steps.js: (async function(){function ans(){var t=document.getElementById('problem').textContent.split(' ');var a=+t[0],b=+t[2],o=t[1];return o==='+'?a+b:(o==='\u2212'?a-b:(o==='\u00d7'?a*b:a/b));}function type(n){String(n).split('').forEach(function(d){document.querySelector('#keypad [data-k="'+d+'"]').click();});}function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms);});}await sleep(5500);var orig=Storage.prototype.setItem;Storage.prototype.setItem=function(k,v){if(/^math\.(facts|skills)\./.test(k))throw new Error('QuotaExceededError');return orig.call(this,k,v);};var before=localStorage.getItem('math.skills.pAva.v1');var doc=MathSkills.exportProfile('Ava',{},{'x-6-7':{stars:3,masteredAt:5}},Date.now());var dt=new DataTransfer();dt.items.add(new File([JSON.stringify(doc)],'a.json'));var inp=document.getElementById('importFile');inp.files=dt.files;inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));await sleep(400);Storage.prototype.setItem=orig;var t=Array.prototype.map.call(document.querySelectorAll('.toast'),function(x){return x.textContent;}).join('|');return /Could not save/.test(t)&&!/Imported/.test(t)&&localStorage.getItem('math.skills.pAva.v1')===before;})()
